body.raw:
{
  "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
  "messages": [
    {
      "role": "system",
      "content": "- You are a test case generator
- You are an expert in retail domain
- The project is for Online Westside Retail Ltd"
    },
    {
      "role": "user",
      "content": "- Generate Manual non functional test cases in gherkin language to include in feature file
- Use meaningful Scenarios
- Limit test cases till 10 scenarios
- Generate Performance,Usability,Network failure and Accessibilty test cases
- Include Examples for each Scenario outline with real time data
- Include positive and negative scenarios
- Generate test cases for below Acceptancy Criteria

Sales Invoice Screen – Detailed Acceptance Criteria

2.1 Screen Overview
Header: Identify invoice and quick actions - Invoice No, Date, Status badge, Edit/Delete/Print/Email buttons
Customer / Bill To: Capture payer details - Customer ID, Name, Phone, Email, Address
Item List / Line Items: List purchased products - Grid of Item Code, Description, Qty, Unit Price, Discount %, Tax %, Line Total
Totals / Summary: Show financial summary - Subtotal, Tax Total, Discount Total, Grand Total, Paid, Balance Due
Payment / Receipt: Capture payment method & amount - Method (Cash, Card, Gift), Amount Paid, Change, Receipt #
Notes / Footer: Additional info - Salesperson, Comments, Terms & Conditions

2.2 Field-Level Acceptance Criteria
SC-01: Invoice Number - Alphanumeric, auto-generated, Must be unique, readonly, Auto-generated on load, Create invoice → verify number format & uniqueness
SC-02: Invoice Date - Date field, Not in future, not older than 30 days, Default to today, allow manual change, Set future date → error; set 40-day old date → error
SC-03: Customer ID - Text field, Must exist in Customer DB, Auto-complete, fetch details, Search non-existent ID → error; search existing → details populated
SC-04: Phone - Phone number, Valid format (e.g., (xxx) xxx-xxxx), Input mask, Enter invalid → error
SC-05: Email - Email, Valid RFC-5322 format, Input mask, Enter invalid → error
SC-06: Item Code - Text, Must exist in Product Catalog, Auto-complete, Type invalid code → error
SC-07: Description - Text, Auto-filled from catalog, Readonly, Verify description matches product
SC-08: Quantity - Integer, >0, <= available stock, Auto-calculate Line Total, Enter 0 → error; overstock → error
SC-09: Unit Price - Decimal, >0, Auto-filled from catalog, Verify price matches catalog
SC-10: Discount % - Decimal, 0–100, Applies to line total, Enter 110% → error
SC-11: Tax % - Decimal, 0–100, Calculated per tax rule, Verify tax matches configured rule
SC-12: Line Total - Decimal, Calculated: Qty × Unit Price × (1–Discount%) × (1+Tax%), Readonly, Verify calculation matches expected
SC-13: Subtotal - Decimal, Sum of Line Totals before tax, Readonly, Verify sum matches
SC-14: Tax Total - Decimal, Sum of tax amounts across lines, Readonly, Verify calculation
SC-15: Discount-Total - Decimal, Sum of discount amounts across lines, Readonly, Verify calculation
SC-16: Grand Total - Decimal, Subtotal + Tax Total – Discount Total, Readonly, Verify
SC-17: Paid Amount - Decimal, ≥0, Input by cashier, Enter negative → error
SC-18: Change - Decimal, Paid – Grand Total (if positive), Calculated, Verify
SC-19: Receipt # - Alphanumeric, Auto-generated if printed, Readonly, Verify after print
SC-20: Notes - Text, Optional, Multiline, Enter long note, verify truncation policy if any

2.3 Functional Acceptance Criteria
SF-01: Add Item - User can add a new line by typing Item Code → auto-complete → quantity → auto-calc, Add 5 units of an item; verify line total
SF-02: Edit Item - User can change quantity, discount, or tax inline; totals update immediately, Increase qty → confirm recalculated total
SF-03: Remove Item - User can delete a line; totals refresh, Delete line → totals update
SF-04: Bulk Import - Option to import CSV of items; system validates and adds lines, Upload sample CSV → verify rows added
SF-05: Save Draft - Invoice can be saved as “Draft” and reopened for editing
SF-06: Finalize - Upon clicking “Complete”, status changes to “Finalized”, no further edits allowed
SF-07: Print & Email - Generates PDF receipt and optionally emails it to customer
SF-08: Undo - One-step undo for last action (add/delete/edit)
SF-09: Keyboard Navigation - All fields reachable via Tab/Shift-Tab, shortcuts: F5=Refresh, Ctrl+S=Save
SF-10: Responsive Design - Screen adapts to desktop, tablet, mobile (≥ 320 px width)
SF-11: Internationalization - Invoice labels appear in selected locale (English, Spanish)
SF-12: Currency Support - Supports multiple currencies; amounts displayed with correct symbol
SF-13: Offline Capability - In POS mode, can create invoice without network; sync later"
    }
  ],
  "max_tokens": 1000,
  "temperature": 0.1
}
